title: Comprehensive usage patterns & API reference for tokens, buttons, tables, and charts
creator: Marisol Vega
description: Goal: Produce a unified, example-driven documentation section on the Design site that bundles: (1) token usage and migration notes, (2) button API and usage patterns, (3) accessible table patterns and API reference, and (4) charts usage with example data shapes. Motivation: multiple product teams report inconsistent usage of tokens and button variants, and engineers request clearer API contract examples for the new prop-driven variants. Scope: create new pages and component reference snippets, interactive examples (codesandbox or Storybook embeds), migration checklist for token name changes, do/don't visual examples, and a small 'breaking changes' note for platform teams. This ticket covers design content, example markup, and editorial review; ENG- dependencies will implement the copy into the component library docs portal and wire up code embeds.
acceptance_criteria: Create separate doc pages for Tokens Migration, Buttons API & Patterns, Tables Accessibility & API, Charts: Data + Rendering Examples
Each page contains at least two live examples: minimal usage and recommended pattern (with code + rendered output), plus one do/don't visual
Tokens page includes automated mapping table (old -> new token keys) and migration checklist with follow-up steps for engineering
Buttons page documents all props, default theme mapping, loading state behavior, and recommended padding/stacking rules for forms
Tables page includes keyboard navigation, sorting example, aria usage, and large dataset rendering recommendation (pagination vs virtual scroll)
Charts page documents data shapes, tooltip conventions, color token usage, and accessible caption/legend guidance
Design review signed off (comment thread resolved) and PR with content merged to docs-staging branch
Links to at least two product teams' migration plans (PM-2147, PM-2199) and recorded handoff meeting notes
